_comment: Copy to a location outside the skill directory, fill in the values, and
or set MAIL_CONFIG=/path/to/mail.json in the environment.

_optional_fields.provider: Leave as auto to derive the server from the address domain. Set explicitly (qq, 163, 126, yeah, gmail, outlook, hotmail, live, yahoo, foxmail, sohu, sina, aliyun, tom) only when the address domain is unusual.
_optional_fields.imap_host: Override only for a custom or corporate server.
_optional_fields.smtp_host: Override only for a custom or corporate server.
_optional_fields.smtp_security: Leave empty to derive from the port: 465 = ssl, 587 = starttls, anything else = plain. Set to ssl / starttls / none to pin it.
_optional_fields.send_as: Set when the From address differs from the login address.
_optional_fields.client_name: Name sent in the RFC 2971 IMAP ID handshake. Optional; defaults to python-mailkit. Some providers (NetEase, QQ) reject login without an ID.
